title: 10 Ways a Godly Man Is Harder on Himself Than He Is on Everyone Else
caption:
Most guys flip this. Soft on their own sin, sharp with everyone around them.

A godly man replays his own mistakes longer than anyone else's. He holds his own excuses to a higher standard than theirs. He gives the benefit of the doubt he refuses himself, right up until conviction's done its work.

Save this and check which one you flipped.

theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
